title: skeleton_spec v2 — input contract of the LegoEnv builder

skeleton_id.description: unique; the builder never sees it as a name to reuse

standin_apps.description: optional: {original SaaS name: our app} for the README

needs_newspecs.description: true when any app is one of the 7 long-tail specs (vikunja/mantisbt/outline/listmonk/cloudreve/directus/mastodon) or chatwoot/misskey

kind.description: from vocab.kind_tools; must have a write tool in this app's spec

pos.description: how many positive predicates this atom should carry (≈ fan-out)

check_kinds.description: from vocab.check_kinds: to what precision the pack checks this atom

carrier.description: from vocab.carriers; where the literal rule text lives in the world (never in the goal)

has_exception.description: the rule has an override clause; at least one distractor must trip exactly it

rule_shape.description: abstract one-sentence shape: which kind of column/condition selects records and what happens; no proper nouns, no literal thresholds

chain.description: abstract intent chain: read carrier → select records → per-record actions → summary

dataset_hint.description: optional datapool slugs that fit; the builder may pick others
